user.description: Connect to an APC Switched Rack PDU (AP79xx and similar) over SNMP. SNMP must be enabled on the PDU's network management card.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the PDU.
data_description.community: A read-write community is needed to switch outlets. Not used with SNMPv3.
data_description.snmp_version: SNMPv3 asks for a user name and keys in the next step.

snmpv3.title: SNMPv3 credentials
snmpv3.description: Enter the SNMPv3 user configured on {host}.

reconfigure.description: Change how Home Assistant reaches this PDU.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the PDU.
data_description.community: A read-write community is needed to switch outlets. Not used with SNMPv3.
data_description.snmp_version: SNMPv3 asks for a user name and keys in the next step.

error.cannot_connect: No answer from the PDU. Check the host, port, SNMP version and community: a PDU ignores requests with a wrong community, so this looks the same as an unreachable PDU.
error.invalid_auth: The PDU rejected the SNMPv3 user name or passphrases.
error.not_supported: The device answered but does not provide the APC rPDU MIB. Only APC Switched Rack PDUs are supported.
error.key_too_short: Passphrases must be at least 8 characters.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different PDU (serial number does not match).

data_description.scan_interval: How often outlet states and load readings are read.

command_failed.message: The PDU did not switch {target}: {error}. Check that the community (or SNMPv3 user) has write access.
